blockingFindings.title: Missing assertion that failed linked-Issue delivery leaves report step non-done
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation could reject after marking the report step done, violating R2 while these tests still pass.
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires a linked-Issue delivery failure to return non-success and prevent the report step from reaching done, but the linked-Issue failure tests only assert rejection. They do not inspect persisted flow state or step status to prove the report step was not marked done.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion in a linked-Issue delivery failure case that the report step/state is not persisted as done.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation could reject after marking the report step done, violating R2 while these tests still pass.

blockingFindings.title: Failed comment delivery state is not covered
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation could correctly persist unsent for missing gh but incorrectly persist done/skipped for failed comments, violating R3 while the current tests pass.
blockingFindings.issue: R3 covers the persisted delivery state only for gh unavailability. It does not cover the failed comment operation path, even though R3 applies whenever linked-Issue delivery cannot complete after report generation.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion for the failed comment operation case that report.json records delivery.status as unsent or pending, never done or skipped.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation could correctly persist unsent for missing gh but incorrectly persist done/skipped for failed comments, violating R3 while the current tests pass.
